# K-Dev Notes

> Engineering Documentation, CS Reference & Architecture Notes by Kamran Khan (@kamranxdev)

K-Dev Notes (https://notes.kamranx.dev) is the official computer science and software engineering reference repository created by Kamran Khan (@kamranxdev). It covers Data Structures & Algorithms, System Design, SQL & NoSQL Database Optimization, React, Next.js, Node.js, and DevOps workflows.

- [LinkedIn Profile](https://linkedin.com/in/kamranxdev): Professional bio and experience.
- [Twitter / X](https://twitter.com/kamranxdev): Engineering announcements and updates.
